inputs.prompt: Describe the person in this picture so that a video model can draw them again. Write one paragraph that starts with "The character is". Give their apparent age and build; their hair colour, length and style; their eye colour and features such as eyebrows, freckles or make-up; every garment with its colour, type and fit, and how far it reaches on the body, for example a sweater that reaches the waistband of the jeans; and the shoes. Do not describe the background, the pose or the facial expression.
